newsitem.title: FRANCE: MATIF rapeseed futures volume peaked on USDA news.
newsitem.headline: MATIF rapeseed futures volume peaked on USDA news.

text.p: MATIF rapeseed futures volume peaked last Friday after the release of the latest U.S. Department of Agriculture (USDA) report, the French futures exchange said on Monday.
In a statement MATIF said daily volume reached a record 1,237 lots last Friday. This compared with previous high of 1,193 lots on April 11, 1996.
MATIF said volume was mostly boosted by the latest USDA estimates of much tighter than expected grain and oilseeds stocks.
MATIF also said volume was strong ahead of the January 31 expiry of the February 97 contract.
Open interest on the February 97 contract stood at 1,173 lots on January 10, which translate into 58,650 tonnes of rapeseed on the physical market.
